games:2026-wk12-san-diego-state-boise-st.blurb: No. 15 Boise State is a 16.5-point home favorite with a 93.8% win probability against San Diego State, and the 62.5 total suggests points will come in bunches. Anything less than a comfortable win would be a blemish on the Broncos' resume.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-georgia-south-.blurb: No. 1 Georgia is a 16.5-point favorite in Columbia with ESPN giving the Bulldogs an 87% chance. Top-ranked teams get everyone's best shot on the road, and Georgia's SEC lead is on the line.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-chattanooga-al.blurb: No. 7 Alabama hosts FCS Chattanooga with no line posted. It's a get-right Saturday for the Tide as they chase Georgia in the SEC race.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-sec.blurb: No. 1 Georgia controls the SEC's automatic bid with No. 7 Alabama the nearest chaser, a six-spot cushion that still leaves the Tide in striking distance.

games:2026-wk12-kentucky-missouri.blurb: No. 17 Kentucky heads to Columbia as a 5.5-point underdog, with ESPN giving Missouri a 61.5% edge. A total of 48.5 suggests a grind, and the Wildcats can't afford another slip in the ranking.

games:2026-wk12-ohio-state-nebraska.blurb: No. 16 Ohio State is only a field goal better than Nebraska in Lincoln, though ESPN still gives the Buckeyes a 71.3% shot. With the number at 41.5, points may be at a premium in a game Ohio State needs for its climb back up.

games:2026-wk12-byu-kansas.blurb: No. 12 BYU lays 5.5 at Kansas with a 71% win probability on ESPN's model. The Cougars are sitting right on the playoff cut line, so there's no margin for a letdown in Lawrence.

games:2026-wk12-texas-tech-baylor.blurb: No. 11 Texas Tech is a 3.5-point favorite at Baylor in the highest-total game of the slate at 57.5. The Red Raiders are chasing Utah in the Big 12 and need every win to stay in that conversation.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-iowa-illinois.blurb: No. 13 Iowa is an 8.5-point favorite at Illinois with a 65.3% win probability, and a 40.5 total that fits the Hawkeyes' style. Iowa sits two spots outside the playoff field, so style points wouldn't hurt.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-utah-tcu.blurb: No. 2 Utah visits TCU laying seven, with ESPN giving the Utes a 73.5% shot. Utah leads the Big 12 race and has the most to lose in a late-night road spot.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-memphis-navy.blurb: No. 24 Memphis is a 3.5-point favorite at Navy in a game Vegas expects to fly, with the total up at 66.5. The newly ranked Tigers are a 63.3% pick by ESPN's model.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-houston-west-v.blurb: No. 20 Houston lays 7.5 in Morgantown against a 70.5 total, the kind of number that suggests neither defense gets many stops. ESPN gives the Cougars a 72.7% chance.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-indiana-washin.blurb: No. 6 Indiana is an 8.5-point favorite in Seattle with a 78.6% win probability. The Hoosiers are two spots behind UCLA in the Big Ten race and can't give one back on the road.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-arizona-kansas.blurb: No. 19 Arizona is a seven-point road favorite at Kansas State, with ESPN putting the Wildcats of Tucson at 74.5%. The total sits at 52.5.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-lsu-tennessee.blurb: LSU is a 1.5-point favorite in Knoxville against No. 9 Tennessee, and ESPN has it at 50.1-49.9 -- about as close to a true toss-up as the model gets. The Vols have the most at stake with their ranking on the line.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-western-kentuc.blurb: No. 22 Liberty lays 17.5 at home against Western Kentucky, with ESPN giving the Flames a 91.9% chance. A 53.5 total means covering requires getting the offense rolling early.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-vanderbilt-flo.blurb: No. 23 Florida is favored by 13.5 over Vanderbilt in the Swamp, with ESPN giving the Gators an 84.7% shot. The total sits at a modest 47.5.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-wofford-ole-mi.blurb: No. 25 Ole Miss hosts FCS Wofford in a game ESPN's model pegs at 99.7% for the Rebels. No line posted, and no suspense expected.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-arkansas-texas.blurb: No. 8 Texas is a 20.5-point favorite over Arkansas with a 94.2% win probability. The 47.5 total suggests the Longhorns are expected to win this one on the defensive end as much as anywhere.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-pittsburgh-lou.blurb: No. 21 Louisville lays 13.5 at home against Pittsburgh, with ESPN giving the Cardinals a 77.5% chance. The total is 50.5.

predictions:kentucky.blurb: Kentucky slid from 11 to 17 this week, and the advanced numbers aren't rushing to defend the Wildcats -- 42nd in SP+ and 34th in FPI.

predictions:boise-state.blurb: Boise State surged from 24 to 15, the week's biggest jump, backed up by a No. 22 SP+ mark. FPI is slightly cooler at 31st.

predictions:ohio-state.blurb: Ohio State moved up four spots to 16, and the metrics think that's still too low -- the Buckeyes sit fourth in SP+ and fifth in FPI.

predictions:ucla.blurb: UCLA holds at No. 4, but the models are skeptical: 12th in SP+ and all the way down at 25th in FPI.

predictions:memphis.blurb: Memphis breaks into the rankings at 24 after being unranked, though SP+ (36) and FPI (52) suggest the Tigers have something to prove.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-ten.blurb: The Big Ten's automatic bid is the tightest race on the board: No. 4 UCLA leads with No. 6 Indiana just two spots behind, close enough that one bad Saturday flips it.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-acc.blurb: No. 5 Miami controls the ACC's auto bid with No. 10 Wake Forest five spots back -- a workable cushion, but not one the Hurricanes can sit on.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-12.blurb: No. 2 Utah has the Big 12 bid in a comfortable grip, with No. 11 Texas Tech the nearest chaser nine spots down. The Red Raiders likely need help.

bubbleNotes:ohio-state.blurb: Ohio State jumped four spots to the 16 seed, the last rung on the bubble and four spots from the field. The arrow is pointing up, but there's ground to make up.

bubbleNotes:oregon.blurb: Oregon climbed two to the 15 seed, still three spots shy of the field. The Ducks are trending the right direction with work left.

bubbleNotes:byu.blurb: BYU slipped two spots to the 13 seed and now sits one spot from the field -- closest of any bubble team, but moving backward.

bubbleNotes:iowa.blurb: Iowa moved up two to the 14 seed, two spots outside the field. Keep winning and the Hawkeyes are very much in this.
